title: aathwe peshwa shaahe hardosara ya imame raza
body:
aathwe peshwa shaahe hardosara ya imame raza ya imame raza
naayebe murtaza sab ke haajat rawa, ya imame raza ya imame raza
<<DIVIDER>>
kya mubaarak mahina hai zeeqaad ka jis me paida hue hai imame raza
hai khushi momino me ye sub'ho masaa, ya imame raza ya imame raza
<<DIVIDER>>
noor se aapke ae shahe do jahan, hogaye hai munawwar ye kouno makaa'n
waj'he rab noore haq noore qairul wara, ya imame raza ya imame raza
<<DIVIDER>>
noore awwal se hai silsila aapka, kitna aali hasab aur nasab aapka
kaise mid'hat baya'n hogi mujh se bhala, ya imame raza ya imame raza
<<DIVIDER>>
qalq ke aap hai jo hajat rawa, tere dar pe sawaali hai shaah o gada
maalike do jahan maz'hare kibriya, ya imame raza ya imame raza
<<DIVIDER>>
hai zamanat me moula ye sab mominee'n, uqde poore karo ya imaame mubee'n
ho shifa'at hamaari bhi roze jaza, ya imame raza ya imame raza
<<DIVIDER>>
bas yahi ilteja hai imame ghareeb, phir se moula ho mujhko ziarat naseeb
jald mujh ko mile ye mera muddua, ya imame raza ya imame raza
